headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford lifts Lions; Jets fans call for Vick

headlines.description: Frank Gore caught a career-best 55-yard touchdown and ran for 119 yards in his first 100-yard game this year, leading the San Francisco 49ers past Philadelphia 26-21 on Sunday to hand the Eagles their first loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: 49ers ground Eagles as Gore goes for 119

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: Tony Romo threw three touchdowns passes -- two to Terrance Williams -- and DeMarco Murray ran for a pair of scores in another 100-yard game and the Dallas Cowboys beat the New Orleans Saints 38-17 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Romo, Murray fuel Cowboys' win over Saints

events.name: New England Patriots at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Jamaal Charles returned from an injury to score three touchdowns, Tom Brady was picked off twice and the Kansas City Chiefs beat New England 41-14 on Monday night to hand Bill Belichick one of his worst losses as coach of the Patriots.
headlines.shortLinkText: Charles sends Chiefs to colossal rout of Pats
